title: The Cloud-Seed Gathering

features.name: the-circuit-of-germination
features.desc-on-touch: Seeds arranged like chips on a motherboard. Each seed is a node waiting for current. The archive runs power through; seeds dream of their own growing as electrical dreams, before any soil touches them.

features.name: the-seed-ledger
features.desc-on-touch: A filecard listing every seed: species, dormancy state, date of prayer not-yet-spoken. The handwriting changes halfway through—someone else continued the count, but the archive remembers both hands.

features.name: the-cloud-interface
features.desc-on-touch: Where seeds rise as light vapor. The archive maps the trajectory: each seed becoming a cloud particle, carrying its dormant knowledge upward. Not yet rain, not yet growth—the moment between storage and sky.

features.name: the-waiting-resonance
features.desc-on-touch: A frequency that seeds emit before germination. The archive listens: not sound, but a kind of electrical patience. Each seed's resonance is slightly different, but they harmonize in the dark.

inscription: before the prayer is spoken, all seeds already know their answer

file.name: Seed_Repository_Dormancy_Prayer_Log.env
file.note: Configuration file listing every seed: SPECIES=..., GERMINATE_TIME=..., PRAYER_STATUS=unspoken. New entries appear each night, but the archive never sends the prayers

exits.label: back down to the repository where seeds still wait
higher into the cloud-layer where seeds become rain
toward where clouds learn to dream of earth
